Interactive tables with DT

Source: R/office.R
phw_datatable.Rd

Builds a DT::datatable() in the PHW style: PHW font, navy header, light row lines, thousands separators, and a title and source line. Useful in Shiny apps and HTML reports when readers need to search, sort or page through a long table. A summary table (see phw_summary_table() and phw_as_summary()) keeps its bold variable and total rows and indented levels, and is shown whole, without sorting or paging.

Usage

phw_datatable(
  data,
  caption = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  digits = 1,
  page_length = 10,
  options = list(),
  caption_args = list(),
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, or a phw_summary table.

caption

Title shown above the table.

source, date

Passed to phw_caption() and shown under the table.

digits

Decimal places for non-integer numbers.

page_length

Rows per page.

options

List of DataTables options, merged with the defaults.

caption_args

List of other phw_caption() arguments.

...

Passed to DT::datatable(), e.g. filter = "top".

Value

A DT htmlwidget (wrapped with the title and source when given).

Examples

if (requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tbl <- phw_datatable(mtcars, caption = "Example table", source = "mtcars")
  # Printing shows the table in the Viewer or a browser.
  if (interactive()) print(tbl)
}
